title: I’m happy with it.
text: Overall I’m quite happy with it and will continue ordering one per month. The products are small, but high quality. I appreciate the wide variety that they send (from staples to snacks to treats). They—to nobody’s surprise—are not cheap by weight or unit. BUT, this shouldn’t surprise anyone because it’s a bunch of vegan food ordered on Amazon... it will never be cheap and it’s silly to expect it to be.
label: positive
